params.attribution: package energy is the whole machine's: each scenario with an energy source also meters an equal window with nothing launched (a11y_poll: its own sleeping window) and reports attributable = window minus baseline, as mean watts; noisy on shared VMs
params.energy_source.note: rapl: no intel-rapl package zones in /sys/class/powercap (VM or unsupported CPU)
params.shell_focus.probe: debug build: settled on the probe's read_ahead_loop line; read-ahead counts reported
params.shell_focus.read_ahead_off.energy_note: rapl: no intel-rapl package zones in /sys/class/powercap (VM or unsupported CPU)
params.shell_focus.read_ahead_on.energy_note: rapl: no intel-rapl package zones in /sys/class/powercap (VM or unsupported CPU)
params.shell_focus.stack: nugget-desktop --minimized (Double Tap on, read-ahead off then on, update channel off, isolated config dir) connected to nuggetd on an empty temporary NUGGET_HOME whose only provider is the fake llama-server on a loopback port (openai_compatible, on-device: read-ahead prefills with cache_prompt; the fake answers at once); a scripted window of focus switches among three text-field windows; shell (with descendants), daemon and server metered separately; the shell restarted between the runs
params.shell_idle.energy_note: rapl: no intel-rapl package zones in /sys/class/powercap (VM or unsupported CPU)
params.shell_idle.probe: debug build: settled on the probe's read_ahead_loop line; read-ahead counts reported
params.shell_idle.stack: nugget-desktop --minimized (hidden in the tray; Double Tap on, read-ahead on, update channel off, isolated config dir) connected to nuggetd on an empty temporary NUGGET_HOME (no providers, [runtime], [mcp] and vault off); nothing in front but the desktop; shell metered with its descendants (webview processes), daemon separately
